title: Dukkhatā (I--IV)
text: [2--33] Tisso imā bhikkhave dukkhatā || katamā tisso || || Dukkhadukkhatā saṅkhāradukkhatā vipariṇāmadukkhatā || imā kho bhikkhave tisso dukkhatā || || Imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave tissannam dukkhatānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya || la || ayam ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo ti || || [page 057] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 57
